rows.note: This is the clearest choice for expressing an opinion about a proposal, issue, or other topic.

example.english: I want to comment on this proposal.
example.traditional: 我想就呢個方案發表意見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zau6 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 faat3 biu2 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday rendering for a person's comment or view, including in 「冇意見」.

example.english: I have no comment on the matter.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gin6 si6 mou5 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this for a comment left on a website, social-media post, or other public message board.

example.english: Remember to leave a comment below the video.
example.jyutping: gei3 dak1 hai2 tiu4 pin2 haa6 min6 lau4 jin4

rows.note: Use this for an evaluative comment or for the activity of commenting, especially in public or more formal discussion.

example.english: There is a comment in the newspaper saying this film is pretty good.
example.traditional: 報紙有篇評論話呢套戲幾好睇。
example.jyutping: bou3 zi2 jau5 pin1 ping4 leon6 waa6 ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use 話 for a plain spoken remark or statement; it is the all-purpose everyday choice when comment simply means say or remark.

example.english: I just want to comment that this arrangement is really convenient.
example.traditional: 我只係想話，呢個安排真係幾方便。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 waa6 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 zan1 hai6 gei2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this specifically when inserting explanatory comments into source code.

example.english: Remember to comment in every section of the code.
example.traditional: 你記得喺每段程式入面加註解。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 dak1 hai2 mui5 dyun6 cing4 sik1 jap6 min6 gaa1 zyu3 gaai2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a remark embedded in source code to explain it to human readers.

example.english: The compiler will not execute the comment in this code.
example.traditional: 呢段程式碼入面嘅註解，編譯器唔會執行。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 cing4 sik1 maa5 jap6 min6 ge3 zyu3 gaai2 pin1 jik6 hei3 m4 wui5 zap1 hang4
